summary: Frontend-only verification of the rewritten MonthCarousel on Home (/) and Destinos (/destinos). Current DB state (today = 2026-08-27) yields 3 upcoming months (Sep/Oct/Nov 2026): only those 3 cards render, no 'Próximamente'/disabled cards, no year-prev/year-next, and no scroll arrows (correct for <=5 months). To exercise the >5-month case I seeded 4 TEST_ trips (Dec 2026, Jan/Feb/Mar 2027) via /api/admin/trips -> 7 month cards, month-carousel-prev/next appeared, next scrolled the rail (scrollLeft 80 -> 316 -> 356) and became disabled at the end; panel expansion, Ver más navigation and WhatsApp link all work on both pages, mobile (390px) included. Seed data deleted afterwards (DB back to 9 trips, 3 month cards). Zero JS console errors / pageerrors. One real defect found: prev arrow is never disabled at the start position.

ui_bugs.issue: 'prev' arrow is never disabled at the initial/leftmost position. The rail uses '-mx-5 px-5 lg:-mx-20 lg:px-20', so its minimum scrollLeft is the horizontal padding (80px desktop / 20px mobile), while canScrollPrev is computed as scrollLeft > 4. Result: at scroll start the prev button looks enabled but clicking it does nothing (scrollLeft stays 80). Requirement 'prev disabled at scroll=0' FAILS. Fix: compare against the rail's real minimum (e.g. track an initial scrollLeft baseline or use scroll-padding instead of px padding).

Because the rail starts scrolled by its 20px inner padding, the first month card sits flush against the left screen edge, misaligned with the section heading/paragraph (20px gutter). Same root cause as above.

Broken cover image (naturalWidth=0): alt text 'Oaxaca Mágico: Mezcal, Mole y Monte Albán' shows instead of an image. src=https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1518614368389-a91ff4a47550?w=1200 . Not part of MonthCarousel but user-visible.

issues: VISIBLE_MONTHS=5 only gates arrow visibility; at 1920px width 6 cards fit and are shown, so 'default 5 months' is not visually enforced (cosmetic, arrows logic still correct)

action_items: Fix canScrollPrev baseline in MonthCarousel so the prev arrow is disabled at the leftmost position (account for the rail's px-5/px-20 padding offset) and the first card aligns with the page gutter.
Replace/fix the broken Unsplash cover image on the Oaxaca Mágico trip.
critical_code_review_comments: MonthCarousel: api.get('/trips') has no .catch and no loading/error state - a failed request leaves the section silently empty (no error UI).
scroll() relies on a hardcoded CARD_STEP=236 and setTimeout(300) to sync arrow state; prefer measuring card width / relying on the onScroll handler only.

rca_of_the_issue: Rail element has negative margins with matching horizontal padding (-mx-20 px-20). With snap-mandatory the browser rests at scrollLeft = padding (80px desktop, 20px mobile), never 0. canScrollPrev = scrollLeft > 4 therefore evaluates true at the leftmost position, leaving the prev arrow permanently enabled and a no-op click.
